what: Per-vertebra miss diagnostic on the C-ArmLSpine test split (Greg 2026-09-25: "what is different about C-arm frames such

core_body_074.label: both-view arms N >= 24, body rule, conf 0.74 (the reported convention)

core_centre_025.label: both-view arms N >= 24, centre rule, conf 0.25 (convention-free, default threshold)

core_outline_074.label: both-view arms N >= 24, whole-vertebra outline rule, conf 0.74

zero_centre_025.label: N = 0 arms (no frame of the device), centre rule, conf 0.25

oneview_own_body_074.label: one-view arms read on their own view, body rule, conf 0.74

render_legend: green = truth body box (SPINEPS corpus, projected); yellow = whole-vertebra outline box; red = predictions of arm N200_s0 at conf >= 0.25 (thick >= 0.74) with confidence written

rules.matching: tools/lcurve_score.load unchanged: greedy one-to-one by confidence; body IoU >= 0.5 with the SPINEPS body box; outline IoU >= 0.5 with the whole-vertebra box; centre = mutual centre containment; hit at op = matched confidence >= op
rules.intervals: Wilson on vertebra x arm trials (arms of one vertebra are not independent; the interval is narrower than the truth); the per-vertebra 'never hit' share carries no interval
rules.truth: C-ArmLSpine truth as rebuilt 2026-09-23 (realxray/carmlspine/meta); boxes kept when >= 50 % of projected points fall in the frame; 'complete' = not cut by the CBCT boundary
